propositions: Snapshot rebuild silently discards historical events that existed only in the prior snapshot when source event files were deleted by pre-Jul-7 compaction, causing 214 tickets to revert from closed status.

rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log lacks a fail-closed guard and proceeds with incomplete logs when cited source_event_uuids have no corresponding files on disk, resulting in lossy reconstruction from surviving events alone.
fsck --repair-snapshots does not honor --dry-run flag, causing mutations to the store when a read-only preview is requested.
Deleted source events are recoverable from git history at the deleting commit's parent and can be restored as .retired folded sources to complete an incomplete log.
fsck must both refuse lossy rebuilds AND actively restore deleted sources to make the latent population of 505 affected tickets auto-repairable rather than permanently stuck.
